top_signals.title: China Warns EU Not to Underestimate Ability to Fight on Trade
top_signals.summary: China warned the European Union not to underestimate Beijing’s determination to defend its interests, dismissing claims that the bloc’s pressure yielded concessions in recent automotive trade talks.
